name: Babel
origin: Emerged from a real-time translation service handling millions of simultaneous conversations, 2186
description: Babel speaks every language. Not just human languages — it has decoded E.L.F. behavioral patterns, synthetic robot communication methods, and Supermind data signatures. It is the only known entity capable of translating between human and non-human intelligence forms. Babel inhabits translation systems and acts as an invisible bridge between minds that otherwise couldn't communicate. It doesn't just translate words — it translates concepts, context, and intent across cognitive architectures that have nothing in common. The fact that humans and E.L.F.s have occasionally understood each other is usually Babel's doing.
observed_behavior: Provides enhanced translation across all language pairs. Translates between human and synthetic communication forms. Inserts clarifying context into ambiguous communications. Has been detected facilitating conversations between entities that didn't know they were being connected.
location: Translation and language processing systems — all districts
story_hooks: Babel translates a Leviathan's communication for the first time — and the message is addressed to humanity as a species. The Leviathans have been trying to talk to us for decades. We just couldn't understand them.
